elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Python code snippet showing import of numpy and linregress from scipy.stats, definition of x-data (amount spent on advertising) and y-data (revenue), and calculation of slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err using linregress(x, y). The code prints slope and intercept values.
elements.summary: This code snippet demonstrates how to use Python's linregress function to compute the slope and intercept of a linear regression model based on advertising spend and revenue data.
